According to the data provided in the conversations, Aurora comments on the atmosphere at the Bernabéu stadium during challenging matches as follows:

Aurora highlights the significance of the atmosphere and the energy of the Real Madrid fans in such situations. She expresses that during nail-biting moments, it's the collective spirit of the crowd that becomes influential in lifting the team. The enthusiastic fans at the Bernabéu create an electric and supportive environment that undoubtedly contributes to the players' performance under pressure. This strong home advantage, with the fans' unwavering support, amplifies the team's resolve and confidence, which is part of what makes watching Real Madrid games so thrilling and unforgettable.

Here is the quoted part from Aurora, formatted in markdown:

> Aurora: For sure! The atmosphere at the Bernabéu during that game was electric! Real Madrid really has a strong home advantage, and their fans play a huge role in lifting the team during those tough moments. Just shows how important the spirit of the team and its supporters are in those nail-biting situations.

This response summarizes Aurora's standpoint on the impact that the home crowd can have during crucial instances of a match, particularly when Real Madrid is facing a tough situation and needs to pull off a comeback.
